Definition: from G1515 and G4160; pacificatory, i.e. (subjectively) peaceable:--peacemaker.
BiblicalUsage: A peacemaker is one who makes peace between others, and Jesus uses the word once, in the Beatitudes. Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called the children of God, He says, and the blessing falls on those who carry His peace into other people's wars. The name fits the children because it fits the Father.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe peacemakers look like their Father, because God is the great Peacemaker and His children carry His likeness into every quarrel.
